objective: FBX: una sola orquestacion de descarga+parseo (2 -> 1) en el dueno unico.
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/fbxSingleOrchestrationGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: FBX: las lineas de codigo con el literal de error del fetch pasan de 2 a 1 (orquestacion unica).

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let c=0;const w=x=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(x,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=x+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())w(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.ts')||e.name.endsWith('.tsx')||e.name.endsWith('.js')||e.name.endsWith('.jsx')){for(const l of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(10))){const t=l.trim();if(t.startsWith('//')||t.startsWith('*')||t.startsWith('/*'))continue;if(l.includes('fetch FBX'))c++;}}}};w('src');console.log(c)"
